label: Records in PostgreSQL
description: A store kept in a PostgreSQL database, and a broker: a queue trigger may receive from a connection of this kind and publish may send to it, the messages kept in one table, wilanis_queue, beside the stores. It delivers at least once, since a worker acknowledges after its run has answered. The URL is a secret, since it carries the credentials; the schema and the pool are facts about this one database, so they sit here rather than in the plugin's settings.

schema.description: the schema the tables live in. Absent: public

pool.description: how many connections this tree may hold open at once. Absent: ten
